title: Fixture Review Checklist
description: Per-fixture human review template. Tracks reviewer sign-off, ambiguity findings, and effort.

reviewer.description: Name or GitHub handle of the reviewer.

reviewer_role.description: Role of the reviewer per fixture governance (section 7.3).

review_date.description: ISO date when review was completed.

verdict.description: Review outcome. needs_language_review means a Hindi/Hinglish reviewer must also sign off.

natural_language_quality.description: Hindi/Hinglish text is natural and professionally fluent.

memory_semantics_correct.description: The expected memory labels, kinds, and content patterns match what the real code produces.

route_classification_correct.description: The expected query route (if specified) matches the routing logic.

safety_classification_correct.description: Safety assertions correctly reflect the crisis/safety exclusion rules.

expected_memory_ids_correct.description: The expected labels and IDs match deterministic code behaviour for the given inputs.

no_overlap_with_existing_tests.description: This fixture does not duplicate an existing direct test in app_database_memory_test.dart or test_context.py.

deterministic_expectations_valid.description: All expectations (storage_expect, query.expect, agent_context_expect) produce correct pass/fail under deterministic replay.

ambiguity_findings.description: Anything the reviewer was unsure about — language nuance, edge-case classification, ID stability.

changes_requested.description: What must change before this fixture is accepted.
